```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
#| raw: true

# GitHub's public events API stopped including commits in PushEvent payloads (only before/head/ref/push_id
# are left), which is why every push used to read "Pushed 0 commit(s)". Commits now come from the compare API
# (before...head), one call per push, and pushes are grouped per repository per day.
# Every text from the API is HTML-escaped before it goes into the page.
import html
import os
from collections import OrderedDict
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone

import requests
from IPython.display import HTML, display

API = "https://api.github.com"
session = requests.Session()
session.headers.update({"Accept": "application/vnd.github+json", "User-Agent": "samarthya.github.io-build"})
if os.environ.get("GITHUB_TOKEN"):  # set in the publish workflow: 1,000+ requests/hour instead of 60
    session.headers["Authorization"] = f"Bearer {os.environ['GITHUB_TOKEN']}"

ZERO_SHA = "0" * 40


def get_json(url, **params):
    try:
        r = session.get(url, params=params, timeout=10)
        return r.json() if r.status_code == 200 else None
    except (requests.RequestException, ValueError):
        return None


def first_line(message, limit=90):
    line = (message or "(no message)").strip().splitlines()[0]
    return line if len(line) <= limit else line[: limit - 1] + "…"


def push_commits(repo_name, payload):
    """(commit count, [first lines of messages]) for one push."""
    before, head = payload.get("before"), payload.get("head")
    if not head:
        return 0, []
    if before and before != ZERO_SHA:
        cmp = get_json(f"{API}/repos/{repo_name}/compare/{before}...{head}")
        if cmp and "commits" in cmp:
            msgs = [first_line(c.get("commit", {}).get("message")) for c in cmp["commits"]]
            return cmp.get("total_commits", len(msgs)), list(reversed(msgs))  # newest first
    one = get_json(f"{API}/repos/{repo_name}/commits/{head}")  # new branch, force push, or compare failed
    if one:
        return 1, [first_line(one.get("commit", {}).get("message"))]
    return 1, []


def describe(event):
    """(summary key, text, details list, commits) for the event types shown, else None."""
    kind, repo, payload = event.get("type"), event.get("repo", {}).get("name"), event.get("payload", {})
    if not kind or not repo:
        return None
    if kind == "PushEvent":
        n, msgs = push_commits(repo, payload)
        return ("push", repo), None, msgs, n
    if kind == "CreateEvent":
        ref_type, ref = payload.get("ref_type", "ref"), payload.get("ref") or ""
        return ("create", repo, ref), f"Created {ref_type} {ref}".rstrip() + f" in {repo}", [], 0
    if kind == "IssuesEvent":
        title = payload.get("issue", {}).get("title", "(no title)")
        return ("issue", repo, title), f"{payload.get('action', 'updated').capitalize()} issue in {repo}", [title], 0
    if kind == "PullRequestEvent":
        title = payload.get("pull_request", {}).get("title", "(no title)")
        return ("pr", repo, title), f"{payload.get('action', 'updated').capitalize()} pull request in {repo}", [title], 0
    return None


def fetch_github_activity(username="samarthya", days=30):
    events = get_json(f"{API}/users/{username}/events/public", per_page=100) or []
    cutoff = datetime.now(timezone.utc) - timedelta(days=days)
    days_map = OrderedDict()  # date -> OrderedDict(key -> item), newest first as the API returns them
    for event in events:
        try:
            when = datetime.strptime(event["created_at"], "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ").replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
        except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError):
            continue
        if when < cutoff:
            continue
        found = describe(event)
        if not found:
            continue
        key, text, details, commits = found
        repo = event["repo"]["name"]
        day = days_map.setdefault(when.strftime("%B %d, %Y"), OrderedDict())
        item = day.setdefault(key, {"repo": repo, "text": text, "details": [], "commits": 0})
        item["details"].extend(details)
        item["commits"] += commits
    return days_map


def render(days_map):
    if not days_map:
        return "<p>No recent GitHub activity to display.</p>"
    out = ['<div class="activity-timeline">']
    for day, items in days_map.items():
        out.append(f'<div class="activity-date">{html.escape(day)}</div><div class="activity-group">')
        for key, it in items.items():
            text = it["text"] or f"Pushed {it['commits']} commit{'s' if it['commits'] != 1 else ''} to {it['repo']}"
            shown = it["details"][:3]
            more = len(it["details"]) - len(shown)
            details = "<br>".join(f"• {html.escape(d)}" for d in shown) + (f"<br>• … and {more} more" if more > 0 else "")
            out.append(
                f'<div class="activity-item"><div class="activity-dot"></div><div class="activity-content">'
                f'<a href="https://github.com/{html.escape(it["repo"])}" class="activity-link" target="_blank" '
                f'rel="noopener">{html.escape(text)}</a><div class="activity-details">{details}</div></div></div>')
        out.append("</div>")
    out.append("</div>")
    return "".join(out)


display(HTML(render(fetch_github_activity())))
```

<div id="projects" class="content-section">

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
#| raw: true

import html
import json
import os
from datetime import datetime

import requests
from IPython.display import HTML, display

def fetch_github_repos(username="samarthya"):
    url = f"https://api.github.com/users/{username}/repos"
    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['GITHUB_TOKEN']}"} if os.environ.get("GITHUB_TOKEN") else {}

    try:
        response = requests.get(url, params={"per_page": 100}, headers=headers, timeout=10)
        if response.status_code == 200:
            repos = response.json()
            # Sort by stars and get top 5
            return sorted(repos, key=lambda x: (x.get('stargazers_count', 0), x.get('forks_count', 0)), reverse=True)[:5]
    except (requests.RequestException, ValueError, json.JSONDecodeError):
        # Handle network/API failures (timeouts, rate limits, JSON errors, etc.)
        # Pass to fall through to return [] below
        pass
    
    return []

repos = fetch_github_repos()

if repos:
    # Build HTML content
    html_content = '<div class="projects-grid">'
    for repo in repos:
        try:
            # Format date with safe access
            updated_at_str = repo.get('updated_at')
            if updated_at_str:
                updated_at = datetime.strptime(updated_at_str, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ').strftime('%B %d, %Y')
            else:
                updated_at = 'Unknown'

            # Fix language color display
            language = repo.get('language')
            language_colors = {
                'java': '#b07219',
                'python': '#3572A5',
                'javascript': '#f1e05a',
                # Add more languages as needed
            }
            language_color = language_colors.get(language.lower(), '#888') if language else '#888'

            html_content += f"""
            <div class="project-card">
                <h3><a href="{html.escape(repo.get('html_url', '#'))}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">{html.escape(repo.get('name', 'Unknown'))}</a></h3>
                <p class="description">{html.escape(repo.get('description') or 'No description available')}</p>
                <div class="stats">
                    <span><i class="fas fa-star"></i> {repo.get('stargazers_count', 0)}</span>
                    <span><i class="fas fa-code-branch"></i> {repo.get('forks_count', 0)}</span>
                    <span><i class="fas fa-circle" style="color: {language_color};"></i> {language or 'Unknown'}</span>
                </div>
                <div class="updated">Last updated: {updated_at}</div>
            </div>
            """
        except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError, AttributeError):
            # Skip individual repos with parsing errors
            continue
    html_content += '</div>'

    # Display the HTML content
    display(HTML(html_content))
else:
    display(HTML('<p>No GitHub repositories to display.</p>'))
```
